extracted.name: Smoked Sausage and Tortellini Skillet
extracted.description: This one-pan sausage tortellini skillet meal is delicious, cheesy, and even better, easy! Mix onion and pepper with sausage, tortellini and cheese.
ingredient_lines: 1 (14 ounce) package Hillshire Farm® Smoked Sausage, diagonally cut into 1/4-inch slices
1 (12 ounce) package fresh cheese tortellini, cooked according to package directions
instruction_lines: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C).

Heat a large 12-inch oven-safe skillet over medium-high heat and add smoked sausage. Cook until brown. Add garlic, onion, and bell pepper. Lower heat to medium and stir until vegetables are soft, about 5 minutes.
Stir in cooked tortellini, marinara sauce, 1 cup cheese, and oregano.
Top with remaining cheese. Bake in the preheated oven until cheese is melted and bubbly, about 10 minutes.
